==Dialogue==
;Quarrel Falls
{{Armorer dialogue}}

;Shining Blade Camp (before Salma is in Lion's Arch)
:''"Any word from [[Loamhurst]]? My mother and father live up there and I haven't heard from them in weeks. I'm worried sick - they say the [[White Mantle|Mantle]] has been burning farms near Loamhurst..."''

;Shining Blade camp (after Salma is in Lion's Arch)
:''"I just heard news from Loamhurst. My parents are dead, burned alive in their farmhouse by [[High Inquisitor Toriimo|Toriimo the Torch]]...because their daughter was loyal to Salma. Now, I've got nothing left inside me but hate."''

;During the Battle for Lion's Arch:
:''"Today, I will strike a blow for my family and for Kryta!"''

;Lion's Arch (War in Kryta):
:''"Now that the fiend Toriimo is dead, I've finally avenged the death of my parents. But I can't celebrate this victory until they've had a proper burial. I think after this I might quit the Shining Blade to go back to Loamhurst. I think it's what they would have wanted."''
